parsed.answer: No, we can't ship a power bank on its own. Lithium batteries shipped on their own are not accepted (P-6). A lithium battery installed inside a device is accepted, so a power bank sent packed inside a device, such as a phone or laptop, may be accepted. Please check with the sender or the carrier before shipping. Let me know if you have any other questions.
